function.name: list_meetings
function.description: List recent Anarlog meetings with pagination metadata. Use query to narrow by title or meeting id, then pass next_offset as offset to continue.

query.description: Case-insensitive title or meeting id substring

limit.description: Maximum results; defaults to 20 and is capped at 200

offset.description: Number of results to skip; defaults to 0

function.name: get_meeting
function.description: Get one Anarlog meeting with its canonical note, summaries, participants, and action items. Use get_meeting_transcript separately for transcript words.

function.name: get_meeting_transcript
function.description: Get a bounded page of transcript words and readable text for an Anarlog meeting. Pass pagination.next_offset as offset to continue.

limit.description: Maximum words; defaults to 200 and is capped at 500

function.name: get_recurring_meeting_history
function.description: List meetings in the same recurring series as the supplied meeting, newest first, with pagination metadata.

meeting_id.description: A meeting id used to resolve its recurring series

limit.description: Maximum meetings; defaults to 20 and is capped at 200

offset.description: Number of meetings to skip; defaults to 0

function.name: search_meeting_content
function.description: Search local meeting notes and transcripts for exact words or phrases. Use search_meetings first for open-ended questions about past meetings, people, decisions, or topics. This is lexical content search, not vector search.

query.description: Text to search for in meeting content

meeting_ids.description: Optional meeting ids to restrict the content search

function.name: read_folder_material
function.description: Read a folder material such as a syllabus, PDF, or text file attached to the current folder. Use the material IDs listed in folder context.

materialId.description: Folder material id from the folder context list

maxChars.description: Maximum material characters to return to the model

function.name: find_related_meetings
function.description: Find meetings related to the current or given meeting by shared participants, the same calendar event, or nearby dates.

meeting_id.description: Meeting id to find related meetings for. Defaults to the currently open meeting.

function.name: search_meetings
function.description:
Search for meetings using note and transcript content plus optional date filters.
Use this first for open-ended questions about past meetings, people, decisions, or topics when the answer may be in meeting notes and no meeting note context is attached.
Use filters.created_at.kind="relative" with recent_days for natural-language date ranges.
Use an empty query string when the user only wants meetings by date/time filter.
Returns relevant meetings with matching content excerpts.

query.description: Optional text query for finding relevant meetings. Omit this when filtering only by date/time.

gte.description: Include meetings on or after this Unix timestamp in milliseconds

lte.description: Include meetings on or before this Unix timestamp in milliseconds

gt.description: Include meetings after this Unix timestamp in milliseconds

lt.description: Include meetings before this Unix timestamp in milliseconds

eq.description: Include only meetings at this exact Unix timestamp in milliseconds

anyOf.description: Absolute timestamp bounds using Unix milliseconds. Use this only when you already know the exact timestamps.

recent_days.description: Use for requests like 'last N days'. Includes today and counts backward in local time.

anyOf.description: Relative date filter. Prefer this over absolute timestamps for natural-language time ranges.

created_at.description: Date filter for meetings. Uses event started_at for event-backed meetings, otherwise meeting created_at.

limit.description: Maximum number of meetings to return

function.name: search_contacts
function.description: Search contacts and return names, emails, phone numbers, roles, and organizations.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return

function.name: search_calendar_events
function.description: Search calendar events and return schedule, location, and linked session info.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return

function.name: web_search
function.description:
Search the public web for current or external information.
Use this for questions about public websites, URLs, companies, products, people, news, or facts that may not be in local notes.
Return source URLs in the final answer when web results are used.
Do not use this when the user is asking only about local notes, meetings, contacts, or calendar events.

query.description: Search query for public web information.

includeDomains.description: Optional domains to search within, for example ['char.com']. Use only when the user names a specific site or domain.

excludeDomains.description: Optional domains to exclude from the search results.

limit.description: Maximum number of web results to return.

function.name: edit_memo
function.description: Propose a complete replacement for a session memo and open a diff review where the user can apply or cancel it. Use this to create or revise meeting preparation, agendas, talking points, and notes before or during a meeting. Preserve relevant existing memo content in the replacement markdown.

sessionId.description: The session ID to edit. Defaults to the current session.

content.description: The complete replacement memo in markdown format

function.name: edit_summary
function.description: Propose a complete replacement for an existing session summary and open a diff review where the user can apply or cancel it. Use this for broad rewrites such as refocusing, shortening, or restructuring a summary. The content must be the full replacement markdown, not instructions or a partial patch.

sessionId.description: The session ID to edit. Defaults to the current session.

enhancedNoteId.description: The specific summary ID (enhanced note ID) to edit. Defaults to the active summary in the session tab when possible.

content.description: The complete replacement summary in markdown format

function.name: apply_session_correction
function.description: Apply a correction to a session summary, visible session title, and/or transcript. Use this when the user corrects note content, for example 'it's not X but Y'. Prefer summary_and_transcript for factual meeting corrections unless the user explicitly asks for one target only. Read the note first if you need exact summary text.

sessionId.description: The session ID to edit. Defaults to the current session.

target.description: Which session content to correct. Use summary only or transcript only when the user explicitly scopes the correction.

enhancedNoteId.description: Optional summary ID to restrict summary edits. Defaults to summaries in the target session.

oldText.description: Exact text currently present in the note or transcript.

dictionaryTerms.description: Uncommon names, company/product names, acronyms, or jargon from the correction to save for future transcription. Skip common names.

function.name: move_meeting_contents
function.description: Move a finished recording, transcript, generated summaries, notes, and action items from one meeting onto another existing meeting. Use this when the user says a recording or notes landed on the wrong meeting. Resolve both meeting IDs with list_meetings or search_meetings first and never guess IDs. The target meeting must not already have a recording or transcript.

sourceMeetingId.description: Meeting that currently has the recording or notes. Defaults to the current meeting.

targetMeetingId.description: Existing meeting that should receive the recording and notes.
